# CC-CEDICT attribution

`hanzi-meanings.js` contains a reduced character-gloss subset and `word-meanings.js` contains a reduced word-gloss subset generated from **CC-CEDICT**, a community-maintained Chinese–English dictionary published by MDBG. The word subset was generated from the 2026-09-25 download; game-specific trade terminology was added to clarify document fields.

- Project: https://cc-cedict.org/
- Download source: https://www.mdbg.net/chinese/export/cedict/
- License: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International
- License text: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/legalcode

The reduced data subsets and game-specific additions remain available under CC BY-SA 4.0. The game selects and condenses entries needed by the displayed training text.
